# Feature Specification: Premium Routing

## Requirements

- **FR-001**: The routing module MUST expose route evaluation from navigation inputs.
- **FR-002**: Premium accounts MUST receive route evaluation.

## Success Criteria

- **SC-001**: A behavior test proves that valid premium inputs produce a viable route result.
- **SC-002**: A non-premium account receives no premium route result.
